title: Settings Limit Queue
prompt: A React settings notification queue should keep only the newest items. Write a helper that appends the next item and returns only the last maxItems entries.

explanation.beginner:
Example: settingsLimitQueue([{"id":"1","text":"One"}], {"id":"2","text":"Two"}, 3) produces [{"id":"1","text":"One"},{"id":"2","text":"Two"}]. The result must follow this precise rule: A React settings notification queue should keep only the newest items. Write a helper that appends the next item and returns only the last maxItems entries. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “drops the oldest item”: input [[{"id":"1","text":"One"},{"id":"2","text":"Two"}],{"id":"3","text":"Three"},2] produces [{"id":"2","text":"Two"},{"id":"3","text":"Three"}]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
